activity_summary: You kept the plain refusal. Garnish had the book, and no part had gone out. Edith's eight shillings was still owing till Lady Day. The letter was still unanswered.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the refusal and left the other two debts where they were.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A clean book does not pay a seam.
